snippet.title: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0 - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The great world tree, Yggdrasil, has long stood watch over the world, providing shelter and bounty for its people. However, the arrival of Dark Lord Asmodeus has Yggdrasil and the world at large on the brink of ruin.
